201:t_021:6.en:
$n
「He's the Emperor of the $$新地球皇国$$!」

201:t_021:8.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「His name is $$アウストラリス$$... He is both Emperor of the $$新地球皇国$$ and ruler of $$サイデリアル$$.」

201:t_021:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「He seems interested in you, if he's gone to the trouble of showing his face.」

201:t_021:10.en:
$$レド$$
「That man... rules $$サイデリアル$$, the greatest power in the galaxy...!」

201:t_022:3.en:
$n
「Without clinging to a convenient hope or letting despair drive me to recklessness...」

201:t_022:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「This is... $n's consciousness... But... it's different... this time...」

201:t_022:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I understand... what you're trying to do, $n...」

201:t_022:7.en:
$n
「This... is what I have to do now!」

201:t_025:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「It deflected the $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$'s full power...!」

201:t_025:2.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...A barrier of spirit quanta... It lives up to its name as the power of God...」

201:t_025:6.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「You're a cursed being...」

201:t_025:7.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「But why... can you move?」

201:t_026:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We'll leave $n's retrieval to them!」

201:t_028:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「The fools didn't know their place. That's what they get for trying to lay a hand on $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

201:t_028:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I don't care about $$アウストラリス$$, but I won't let lowly Earthlings touch that city blessed by the $$黒い太陽#sol$$.」

201:t_028:4.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「There's no need to worry, $$ストラウス$$. More to the point...」

201:t_028:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「He brought the $$いがみ合う双子$$ to the Third Stage, even if only for an instant... I'll give him credit for that.」

201:t_028:6.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「But this is good news for us too.」

201:t_028:7.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「$$ジ・オーバーライザー$$... You will offer up that power to me.」

201:t_029:0.en:
$$メラン$$
「Five minutes have elapsed since the operation began!」

201:t_029:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「If we stumble here, we'll never take the Imperial Palace!」

201:t_029:2.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, retreat! The operation has failed!」

201:t_031:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You seem a little better thanks to the flow of $$オリジン・ロー$$, $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$.」

201:t_031:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I've heard of you, cursed wanderer.」

201:t_031:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「No one can decide another's happiness. Even a god.」

201:t_031:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That's why I seek... the path to $$太極$$.」

201:t_032:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Hold the ship at this position! We'll cover our allies' withdrawal!」

201:t_033:0.en:
$$ボビー$$
「We've reached the target point! What now, Boss?!」

201:t_033:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Hold the $$クォーター$$ here! Keep firing until we've seen all our allies withdraw!」

201:t_034:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「We've reached the target point! Your orders, Captain!」

201:t_034:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「Hold this position and concentrate on firing! Keep us going until every allied unit has withdrawn, whatever it takes!」

201:t_035:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Some units are still out there! We'll hold out here until they withdraw!」

201:t_100:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Here we come, $$サイデリアル$$! We'll smash your headquarters and turn this around in one stroke!」

201:t_101:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Wait for me, Mom, $$サチ子$$, $$しげる$$! $$かおる$$, Miss $$美重子$$, Mr. $$大門$$, $$健一$$, $$アキラ$$! And everyone in class too!」

201:t_101:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'll beat $$サイデリアル$$ here and protect Japan, no matter what!」

201:t_102:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do this, $$鉄人$$! Our target is the palace where the Emperor is!」

201:t_102:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We'll stop the Empire here and turn things around!」

201:t_103:0.en:
$$タケル$$
(This overwhelming presence dominates the battlefield... What... is it...?)

201:t_103:1.en:
$$タケル$$
(Is there another $$スフィア・リアクター$$ we don't know about in this capital...?!)

201:t_104:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
(It resembles the ruins on planet $$クエント$$...)

201:t_105:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(This aggressive pressure... If I stay still, it feels as if it'll pierce right through me.)

201:t_105:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(Where are they...? When are they going to show themselves...?!)

201:t_106:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Even if they lured us in, this is still an opportunity...!」
